findings: Generic source-shape validation is not joined to selector state: a verified executable can be fabricated for selector 2 and a verified sealed stdin can be fabricated on selector 0's DEVNULL branch; pre-fork devnull_identity is also unconstrained.
Selector-0 request sink may claim failed creation while retaining successful counters and artifact binding, and a successful request sink may retain a nonzero fd relocation error.
The review-28 regression test asserts hashes but never invokes its loaded archive31 oracle and omits valid empty and 254-byte sample controls.
required_next: Join exact absent executable/stdin and devnull state to pre/post selector paths while retaining producer flags equal to 3.
Require reached successful sinks to retain created/fd/path/hash state and zero creation/fd errors while preserving the exact selector-1 create and selector-2/6 write failures.
Exercise archive31 acceptance and current rejection for all five review-28 canonical fixtures and retain empty/254-byte positive samples.
Rerun both pinned suites and pycompile, freeze a fresh archive and obtain fresh independent review.
